reviews.title: Fans are pre installed on the exhaust side
reviews.comment: The only reason I gave it 4 stars is due to the fans being pre installed onto the radiator. I thought that was going to be convenient however the radiator I replaced in my box was set up on the front as “Intake” and these are pre installed as “exhaust”. My computer was overheating like crazy because I didn’t know which way the fans were supposed to be facing. I eventually found out and flipped them over. The product itself seems to be working just fine so far. One tip is still buy your own thing of thermal paste. The one it comes with isn’t enough imo.
